comment.narrative: 1 free online webinar between CSOs at EU level and Turkish CSOs on article 45 on emission reductions for coal power plants.

1. On 16 June 2020 the Webinar COVID19 Pandemic and Climate Change in the frame of One Health took place with speakers Prof. Dr. Selim Badur Prof. Dr. Doanay Tolunay Istanbul University Faculty of Forestry and Vet. Dr. Ahmet Emre Ktk WWFTurkey. The event was moderated by Prof. Dr. idem alayan. The webinar has now been watched by 234 people on YouTube. 2. On 21 July 2020 we organised the Webinar Heatwaves and Public Health in Turkey in collaboration with Istanbul Policy Center. Speakers included Dr.Toker Ergder WHO Turkey Dr. mit ahin Istanbul Policy Center Dr. Peter van den Hazel President of INCHES and Dr. Karine Laaidi French Public Health Agency to share information on the science on heatwaves and health health alert systems and other policy measures to better protect people. 3. On 17 December 2020 we organised a webinar on Which role for the Turkish health sector in environment and climate as part of HASUDERs 4th International 22nd National Congress on Public Health.Speakers included Ms. Evrim zturk air quality expert at the European Enviroment Agency who provided the first ever presentation of EEAs report on Healthy Environment Healthy Lives to a Turkish audience Prof Marija Jevtic Chair of the environment Section of the European Public Health Alliances EUPHA Dr. Peter van den Hazel President of INCHES and Mr. Mr. Alper Acar European Union Delegation to Turkey. The webinar was moderated by Anne Stauffer HEAL. 4. On18 April 2021 we organised the webinar Health Effects of Fossil Fuels through Climate Change and Air Pollution and Solutions webinar in the 1st International Health and Climate Change Congress. Approximately 50 participants followed the event alive.5. On 9 June 2021 Panel discussion on Heatwaves Health Water and Cities as part of Marmara Municipalities Union event MARUF 2021. 24 participants followed the event online and 124 watched via Youtube.Turkish version httpswww.youtube.comwatchvgL6wY2k5Blot181s6. On 14 December 2021 panel discussion on A Green Deal for Turkey to tackle Climate Change and its Health Impacts as part of HASUDERs annual congress. 139 participants followed the event online and 44 watched via youtube.Turkish version httpswww.youtube.comwatchvkmJWyQe16p8English Version httpswww.youtube.comwatchvA0JU8jEW0Q
